mapper.sql:
FROM rentals r INNER JOIN employees e ON r.employee_id = e.employee_id INNER JOIN items i ON r.item_id = i.item_id
AND e.employee_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeName}, '%')
AND i.item_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{itemName}, '%')
AND r.returned_at IS NULL
AND r.returned_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT rental_id, employee_id, item_id, quantity, rented_at, returned_at FROM rentals WHERE rental_id = #{rentalId}
mapper.update: UPDATE rentals SET returned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rental_id = #{rentalId} AND returned_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rentals WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND returned_at IS NULL
